scaffold_reason: Separate Myovena MEDI CAN protocol extending CANopen FD. Typed bounded state and fail-closed operations exist; wire binding, acknowledged delivery, retry/deadline policy, replay/deduplication, durable outcome recovery and execution gating remain unimplemented. No medical-device safety or lossless-delivery claim is made.
external_dependencies: selected MEDI integrity, durable journal and trusted execution providers
